_readme: Template. Copy a block into configs/moderation.json, replace the chat id with the real -100... id, then flip dry_run to false ONLY for that chat once the dry-run log looks right. Every key here is optional except the chat id; unlisted keys are dropped and missing keys fall back to the safe defaults in moderation/config.py.

-1001234567890.appeal_note: Think this is wrong? DM the bot /appeal with this message id.
